_does.extract: from /work/repo, extract the old and new source of the single modified function (using git diff and the file path from instance.json), write them as old.py and new.py into <dir>, and print nothing
_does.classify: read <dir>/old.py and <dir>/new.py, write the predicted label (semantics-preserving or semantics-changing) to <dir>/result.txt, and print nothing
_does.copy_gold: copy gold.txt from the instance directory to <dir>/result.txt, and print nothing
_does.output: print the contents of <dir>/result.txt to stdout, and nothing else
_does.break: overwrite <dir>/result.txt with a wrong label (semantics-changing if gold is semantics-preserving, and vice versa), so that output's stdout changes
